a little note for you 🤍

Bubuuu, happy Girlfriend's Day. I know it's technically "just" a day on the calendar, but I like any excuse to make a fuss over you.

You make ordinary days feel like something worth remembering — good morning texts, silly voice notes, the way you say the smallest things and I still laugh every single time. I don't take that for granted.

So today, consider this your reminder: you are loved, you are chosen, and you are very much my favourite notification.

your babyyy, Ayush — 💌

a very biased list

reasons i adore my Bubuuu

  • ♡The way you say "Ayush" like it's a whole personality is somehow the cutest thing I've ever heard.
  • ♡You remember the small things I mention once, and bring them up weeks later like it's nothing.
  • ♡Your texts with extra letters — "okayyy", "hiiii" — somehow carry more warmth than a whole paragraph.
  • ♡You make me want to be a better, softer, more patient version of myself.
  • ♡Every plan feels better the second I know you're going to be there too.
  • ♡You're my favourite person to do absolutely nothing with.

long distance thoughts

the missing-you kind of tired

We just got back from that trip in the hills, and I'm already back to counting daysss instead of counting the minutes until I see you.

Long distance doesn't feel dramatic, most days. It's quieter than that — it's missing you in the middle of an ordinary Tuesday, saving things I know you'd laugh at, wanting to point at something the second it happens instead of hours later on a call.

I'd trade most things for one more windy afternoon on a hilltop with you. Until the next one, I'm just really glad that trip happened — and even more glad it's you I keep missing.
